title: Air-gapped OCI image index + offline upgrade graph generator for private installer
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: Private/on-prem customers need an offline-friendly release artifact that lets air-gapped clusters perform deterministic upgrades and rollbacks without direct access to public registries. Current private-installer flows rely on full image bundles (tarballs) and manual upgrade sequencing, which are brittle for large fleets and create operational churn.

This PR introduces two complementary pieces: (1) an OCI-compliant 'airgap index' generator that builds delta-aware OCI index files and a corresponding signed index manifest bundle suitable for shipping to an offline registry or as a registry cache tarball, and (2) an offline upgrade-graph generator that produces a versioned DAG (DOT + JSON) describing valid upgrade/rollback transitions between release artifacts for the private-installer. Both artifacts are signed using the existing cosign integration and include provenance metadata (build id, git ref, sigstore bundle ref).

What changed (high level): added an oci/index builder to the release toolchain that can emit layered index deltas (base->minor->patch) optimized for minimal blob transfer; extended the private-installer CLI to accept an --airgap-index input and a --upgrade-graph for canary/rollback validation; added a new release CI job to publish signed index bundles to the artifact store and to validate offline integrity by loading the index into a local mock-registry (registry v2 test harness). Updated Terraform module for private registry bootstrap to support service-account tokens for image preloads and added Helm post-renderer hooks to generate local imageLoad manifests when deploying in air-gapped mode.

Testing & validation: unit tests for the index serializer and graph generator, integration test that simulates a registry cache import + deployment on a KinD cluster with network partitioning, and a regression test that verifies that rolling back to a previous patch uses the precomputed delta set and does not require full image re-push. CI includes cosign verification and an attestations scan.

Checklist: 
- [x] index generation and serializer
- [x] cosign signing and bundle storage
- [x] private-installer CLI accept/import logic
- [x] upgrade graph DOT/JSON generator and validator
- [x] terraform registry auth helper
- [x] helm post-renderer for airgap imageLoad
- [x] unit + integration tests
- [x] CI job + gating

Migration notes: this is opt-in via the release pipeline flag `release.airgap_index=true`. Existing tarball flows remain supported. Operators will be able to use the upgrade-graph to precompute safe canary-to-production rollouts and to perform offline verification before applying upgrades.

Security considerations: signatures are produced with the existing KMS-backed cosign keys; the PR adds verification steps in the installer preflight to ensure index signatures chain to a known cosign root. The upgrade graph contains no secrets but does reference signed manifests and artifact digests.

Rollout plan: land on main behind feature flag; coordinate with release-engineering to produce two pilot airgap index bundles for customers in the compliance beta program.
commits: 4 commits: 1) add oci/index builder + serializer; 2) extend release pipeline: airgap-index artifact publish + cosign signing; 3) private-installer: import & preflight checks for airgap-index + upgrade-graph validation; 4) tf module + helm post-renderer + tests

Luca Ortega: Can the index builder produce deterministic ordering across platforms?
Maya Chen: Yes — index_serializer normalizes descriptors and sorts by digest+mediaType; unit test added to ensure determinism.

Maya Chen: Fixed by pinning the test-harness to v0.8.2 and adding an explicit CA bundle step in the harness; re-ran CI.
Samir Gupta: We should ensure the terraform helper doesn’t create long-lived service tokens. Consider short-lived bootstrap tokens instead.
Maya Chen: Updated terraform module to create a bootstrap token with TTL and documented rotation guidance in docs/airgap-index.md.

Maya Chen: Addressed log verbosity and squashed commits.

release_notes:
- Added air-gapped OCI index bundles and signed index manifests for offline registry imports.
- Introduced an offline upgrade-graph generator (DOT/JSON) to precompute safe upgrade/rollback paths.
- Private-installer can now import signed index bundles and validate upgrade graphs before applying changes.
- Terraform helper to bootstrap private registry preload tokens and Helm post-renderer for imageLoad manifests.
